Mars.Mars: If (the Moon) is in a navamsa of Mars and if it is aspected by Mars, (the native) is a fierce thief who takes pleasure in murder and killing.
Mars.Venus: If aspected by Venus, one who is rich in drink, wealth, and women.
Mars.Mercury: If aspected by Mercury, a thief who keeps changing his residence.
Mars.Sun: If aspected by the Sun, a guardian who kills Dasyus.
Mars.Jupiter: If aspected by Jupiter, an intelligent king rich in good qualities.
Mars.Saturn: If aspected by Saturn, an angry man attached to strife who is dragged down by many fears.

Venus.Venus: The Moon in a navamsa of Venus, if it is aspected by Venus, produces a happy man rich in grain, wealth, and women.
Venus.Mercury: If aspected by Mercury, one who knows such things as singing and speaking.
Venus.Jupiter: If aspected by Jupiter, a poet of famous intellect.
Venus.Mars: If aspected by Mars, a lover of other men's wives.
Venus.Sun: If aspected by the Sun, one who has abundant food and drink, but little intelligence.
Venus.Saturn: If aspected by Saturn, a hero delighting (women) by sexual intercourse or an expert in sexual intercourse.

Mercury.Mercury: The Moon in a navamsa of Mercury, if it is aspected by Mercury, produces an eloquent man who knows such things as the meaning of the sciences and the crafts.
Mercury.Venus: If aspected by Venus, an expert in singing, story-telling, and sexual intercourse.
Mercury.Jupiter: If aspected by Jupiter, the counsellor (saciva) of a king, one who understands politics.
Mercury.Mars: If aspected by Mars, an intelligent and prominent thief.
Mercury.Sun: If aspected by the Sun, an actor who knows the rules.
Mercury.Saturn: If aspected by Saturn, an intelligent man learned in the rules of the crafts.

Moon.Sun: The Moon in its own navamsa, if it is aspected by the Sun, produces a man whose wallet and body are both thin and who experiences much sorrow from riots.
Moon.Mars: If aspected by Mars, a greedy person who delights in taking money.
Moon.Jupiter: If aspected by Jupiter, a wise man of noble firmness.
Moon.Venus: If aspected by Venus, one addicted to the posture and acts of women.
Moon.Mercury: If aspected by Mercury, an ascetic who restrains himself.
Moon.Saturn: If aspected by Saturn, a clever person who is wise in his activities, but is afflicted by sorrow arising from bondage and wandering.

Sun.Sun: The Moon in a navamsa of the Sun, if it is aspected by the Sun, produces a very angry man, a drunkard who is not to be assailed.
Sun.Mars: If aspected by Mars, a cruel man who is wealthy and honored by the king.
Sun.Saturn: If aspected by Saturn, a destroyer of life.
Sun.Venus: If aspected by Venus, a wealthy man who is afflicted by grief caused by his wife and sons.
Sun.Mercury: If aspected by Mercury, one who delights in slander.
Sun.Jupiter: If aspected by Jupiter, a rich, fat man.

Jupiter.Jupiter: The Moon in a navamsa of Jupiter, if it is aspected by Jupiter, produces a man of pure character who possesses intelligence and courage.
Jupiter.Venus: If aspected by Venus, a firm man attached to the objects of the senses.
Jupiter.Mercury: If aspected by Mercury, one who is learned in poetry and in the sacred traditions (sruti).
Jupiter.Mars: If aspected by Mars, a fierce man clever with swords and weapons.
Jupiter.Sun: If aspected by the Sun, a strong, but infamous man.
Jupiter.Saturn: If aspected by Saturn, a wise man who looks like an elder and has a bad king.

Saturn.Saturn: The Moon in a navamsa of Saturn, if it is aspected by Saturn, produces a pitiable pauper racked by disease.
Saturn.Mars: If aspected by Mars, a wealthy man with many sorrows.
Saturn.Sun: If aspected by the Sun, a cruel person whose property has vanished.
Saturn.Venus: If aspected by Venus, one who possesses old women, widows, and women of bad character.
Saturn.Mercury: If aspected by Mercury, a man who enjoys suffering.
Saturn.Jupiter: If aspected by Jupiter, a well behaved and distinguished person who is intent on good conduct and on giving pleasure.
